scripts.check: tsc -b tsconfig.json && pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run codegen --check && strider-codegen generate cdp --check && strider-codegen generate bidi --check && strider-codegen generate webkit-stock --check && strider-codegen generate webkit-automation --check && strider-codegen keyboards --check && node packages/tools/utils/src/bin.mjs readme --check
scripts.build: node packages/tools/utils/src/bin.mjs clean && tsc -b tsconfig.packages.json && pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run build
scripts.test:integration: nix develop .#integration --ignore-environment --keep TERM --keep STRIDER_RECORD --keep STRIDER_UPSTREAM_SAMPLES --keep STRIDER_INTEGRATION_JOB --command pnpm exec vitest --run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:upstream: nix develop .#integration --ignore-environment --keep TERM --keep STRIDER_UPSTREAM_SAMPLES --keep STRIDER_UPSTREAM_RUN --command pnpm exec vitest --run --config vitest.upstream.config.ts
scripts.website:dist: pnpm jsdocs && pnpm api-reference && pnpm website:build
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm pack-check && changeset publish
scripts.all: pnpm check && pnpm lint && pnpm test --run && pnpm test-types && pnpm reference && pnpm website:check && pnpm website:build && pnpm matrix:check --built
scripts.reference: pnpm jsdocs && pnpm examples && pnpm index && pnpm api-reference
scripts.codegen:protocol: strider-codegen generate cdp && strider-codegen generate bidi && strider-codegen generate webkit-stock && strider-codegen generate webkit-automation
scripts.codegen:audit: strider-codegen audit cdp && strider-codegen audit bidi && strider-codegen audit webkit-stock && strider-codegen audit webkit-automation
